The stir-fry mixture persists in its initial arrangement without stirring or tossing during the simmering.

caption: The video captures a close-up view inside a stainless steel wok holding a stir-fry mixture of shredded orange carrots, pale white sprouts, and brown meat strips. A thin metal utensil shaft with a white grip rests at the left edge of the pan, partly buried in the food. A plume of steam rises continuously above the contents, swirling, thinning, and shifting position as the main visible motion. The food pieces themselves stay in essentially the same arrangement throughout, with no stirring or tossing occurring. The camera framing drifts slightly, progressively revealing more of the white utensil grip that is mostly hidden at the left edge. The utensil does not move relative to the food, its growing visibility arising from the framing change rather than object motion. The simmering and steaming of the dish continues steadily.
